reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that manually or automatically rewrites eligible user prompts through an auxiliary LLM before execution, with append or replace delivery modes.

summaries.zh: 通过辅助大语言模型手动或自动优化符合条件的用户提示词，并支持在执行前追加或替换优化结果。
summaries.en: Manually or automatically rewrites eligible user prompts through an auxiliary LLM before execution, with append or replace delivery options.

capabilities: Sends auxiliary LLM requests to rewrite eligible prompts
Adds a Web UI control for manual prompt optimization
Automatically optimizes qualifying direct-user messages before agent execution
Can append or replace optimized prompt text
Exposes prompt optimization through the /optimize-prompt command
